question: Which other two countries were at the top in the world to possess an anti-satellite weapon system in 2010 when China became the third country?
solution:
The Correct answer is **__The USA and Russia.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• USA and Russia are the other two at the top in the world to possess an anti-satellite weapon system in 2010 then China became the third country
 
• Due to the necessity of these types of satellites for national security, **countries have developed anti-satellite (ASAT) weapons** which can be used to destroy satellites in an orbit.
 
• Although no ASAT system has yet been utilized in war, A few countries like **China, India, Russia, and the United States **have successfully shot down their own satellites to show a demo of their ASAT capabilities in a show of force.
 
• ASATs have also been used to remove decommissioned satellites.
 
• **Anti-satellite weapons, commonly referred to as ASATs, are any weapon that can temporarily impair or permanently destroy an orbiting satellite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Functions of Anti-Satellite Weapons:__**

 
 
• Defensive measures against an adversary's space-based and nuclear weapons
 
• A force multiplier for a nuclear first strike.
 
• A countermeasure against an adversary's anti-ballistic missile defense (ABM).
 
• An asymmetric counter to a technologically superior adversary, and a counter-value weapon.
